protocols.title: HGH 191AA (10IU Vial) Dosage Protocol — source reference
protocols.purpose: Individual-page schedule and handling details, transcribed as a research/educational reference
protocols.evidenceNotes: Secondary commercial source; these are the page's statements, not independently verified clinical guidance. Page reports conservative replacement reference 150–500 mcg/day, beginning near 200 mcg and increasing by ~100 mcg/week; advanced research amounts up to 1,000–2,000 mcg/day are also mentioned. 10 IU vial + 3 mL is concentration math. Somatropin is a prescription medicine; use only under clinician direction.

schedule.description: The source distinguishes conservative replacement references (150–500 mcg/day) from advanced research amounts (1,000–2,000 mcg/day); it begins near 200 mcg and describes ~100 mcg weekly increments.

regimen.notes: Source describes prescription somatropin label/replacement context and research ranges. A research vial is not an approved product; dose must not be treated as self-administration guidance.
